statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), r[i] equals the sum over all indices j with 0 <= j < len(nums) and j != i of |nums[i] - nums[j]|, where |a-b| denotes the nonnegative absolute difference of the two integers (a-b if a >= b, and b-a otherwise).
